headline: U.S. Drops Atomic Bomb on Hiroshima; City Obliterated in Single Blast
dispatch: An American B-29 bomber released a single atomic device over the Japanese city of Hiroshima this morning, devastating the city in an instant. Military officials estimate tens of thousands were killed outright, with fires and destruction spreading across the urban center. The weapon represents a new order of destructive power never before used in warfare.
answer: Enola Gay drops Little Boy atomic bomb on Hiroshima, 1945
